note: Question-mark help. Terms here merge over the built-in glossary by id. Fields: id, title, group, alsoCalled, meaning, impact.

terms.title: Habitat need
terms.alsoCalled: how they pick stars, climate taste
terms.meaning: What kind of world this culture wants: humanlike carbon-band, sulfur-band, methane/gas-giant, high-sky, rim/poor, or any catalog star. This is not the culture’s name.
terms.impact: Combined with start/direction bias. Save factions before you generate; generate can paint the map from these rules.

terms.title: Start / direction bias
terms.alsoCalled: selection bias, home wedge, near/far host
terms.meaning: Where they start looking: nowhere in particular, a wedge from a home star, a pocket around a star, the rim, or a sky quarter. Independent of the culture’s display name.
terms.impact: A methane-breather can still start near Tau Ceti. Bias without a need just means ‘that patch of sky, any habitat.’

terms.title: Gap-fill (bodies)
terms.meaning: Reality 1 lets you invent stub moons and similar bodies. It is not a jump-range tool and it does not add stars or roads.
terms.impact: Use Scan jump gaps on Generate map to find holes larger than Longest single jump.

terms.title: Jump gaps
terms.meaning: A jump gap is two qualified planet-hosts farther apart than Longest single jump. That 16.4 ly is to the nearest Goldilocks/planet star, not necessarily to any star. Filling looks first for a real catalog object within hop range of both ends, then places a 0.25 M☉ star on the line if none exists.
terms.impact: The NASA exoplanet archive only includes stars with confirmed or suspected planets. A Gaia/Hipparcos stellar catalog is the missing dataset for dim real bridges. Until that ingest exists, midpoint 0.25 M☉ stars are the fill. Persisting them as setting documents needs reality 4.

terms.title: Stellar catalog vs exoplanet archive
terms.meaning: Jumpgate’s shipped list is NASA’s exoplanet archive: hosts that already have planets. Most nearby M-dwarfs with no known planets are absent. A stellar catalog (Gaia DR3 / Hipparcos) lists those objects by XYZ so a gap-fill can pick a real dim star before inventing a 0.25 M☉ placeholder.
terms.impact: Until that file is ingested, scans can only search planet-hosts. Isolated 16.4 ly holes in this list usually have no real first hop.
